spans.s: (I)--a lunar period of १५ days; शुक्ल (white) and कृष्ण (dark). Br. II. २१. १२५; २४. ५६; २८. ३३;
(II)--a मणिवर Yaks2a and son of देवजनी. Br.
--a species of birds vanquished by रावण; the name of a मूर्छन after their name. Br.
--a शक्ति on the षोडश--पत्राब्ज. Br. IV. ३२. ११.
--an Asura; resisted Indra and मातलि in देवासुर war and was slain. भा.

--विधान of: to be observed by the husband in his fire offerings in the Pumsavana (s.v.) vratam,
1: भा. VI. १९. २२: वा. २९. ३८.
prescribed for शूद्रस्.
2: Vi.

--Indra, the lord of rains;
1: Br. III. ६३. ९९; ६६. ३५;

. ५१. वा. ८८. ८५.
fought with the Asuras and got the full share of यज्ञस् for devas and deprived them of their place.
